nodes.description: OER performance comparison of different molecular complexes on glassy carbon electrode
nodes.source_text: The electrocatalytic OER performance of different molecular complexes was evaluated on a glassy carbon electrode in an N₂-saturated 1.0 M KOH electrolyte. First, FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C show more intensive redox peaks of cyclic voltammetry (CV) curves and higher catalytic performance than that of FeNi-BPDA

nodes.description: LSV OER performance on carbon cloth with high current density
nodes.source_text: FeNi-BPDA/C(O) only requires an overpotential of 330 mV to achieve a current density of 1.5 A cm⁻²... Tafel slope (42 mV dec⁻¹)... mass activity (41,206 A g_Fe/Ni) at 1.56 V

nodes.description: High current density OER on carbon cloth in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: FeNi-BPDA/C(O) only requires an overpotential of 330 mV to achieve a current density of 1.5 A cm⁻², significantly lower than that of FeNi-BPDA/C (380 mV). FeNi-BPDA/C(O) exhibits a lower Tafel slope (42 mV dec⁻¹) than that of FeNi-BPDA/C (48 mV dec⁻¹)
The FeNi-BPDA/C(O)-based electrolyzer requires only 1.90 V to achieve a current density of 1 A cm⁻²... displays a negligible decrease in cell current density after 40 h of tests
which is lower than that of FeNi-BPDA/C (2.15 V)

nodes.description: CV curves comparison of different C(O)-supported catalysts
nodes.source_text: the CV curves present that the C(O)-supported metal complexes exhibit more obvious redox peaks (Figure 3a)

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-IR spectra show similar characteristic peaks for FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C, demonstrating that oxygen functional groups do not directly alter the coordination structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: FT-IR and Raman spectra analyses show that FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C show similar characteristic peaks, thus demonstrating that the oxygen functional groups would not directly alter the coordination structure (Figures S14 and S15).

nodes.characterization_summary: X-diffraction patterns of FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C exhibit only characterization peaks belonging to carbon substrates, indicating molecular dispersion of metal sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-diffraction patterns of all samples exhibit only the characterization peaks belonging to carbon substrates, indicating the molecular dispersion of metal sites (Figures 1c and S7).

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution HAADF-STEM images show marked bright spots confirming uniform distribution of Fe-Ni molecular sites in FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In high-resolution high-angle annular dark-field scanning TEM (HAADF-STEM) images, the marked bright spots further confirm the uniform distribution of Fe-Ni molecular sites in FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C (Figure 1d,e).

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution Fe 2p and Ni 2p XPS spectra of FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C show higher valence states of Fe and Ni species in FeNi-BPDA/C(O).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution (f) Fe 2p and (g) Ni 2p XPS spectra of FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C.

nodes.characterization_summary: XANES spectra at Fe and Ni K-edge show higher oxidation state of Fe (+3.20) and Ni (+2.25) in FeNi-BPDA/C(O) compared to FeNi-BPDA/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The quantitative absorption energy analyses demonstrate a higher oxidation state of Fe (+3.20) and Ni (+2.25) species in FeNi-BPDA/C(O) when compared with FeNi-BPDA/C and FeNi-BPDA (Figures 2c,d and S16, Tables S4 and S5).

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS reveals Fe/Ni-O bonds around 2.00 Å and Fe/Ni-O-C bonds around 2.85 Å; FeNi-BPDA/C(O) exhibits shorter Fe/Ni-O2/C2 coordination bonds than Fe/Ni-C2 bonds in FeNi-BPDA/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fourier transform extended X-ray absorption fine structure (FT-EXAFS) with fitting analysis reveals that FeNi-BPDA/C(O) and FeNi-BPDA/C feature similar lengths of Fe/Ni-O bonds (around 2.00 Å) in the first coordination sphere and Fe/Ni-O-C bonds (around 2.85 Å) in the second coordination sphere... FeNi-BPDA/C(O) exhibits shorter Fe/Ni-O2/C2 coordination bonds than the Fe/Ni-C2 bonds in FeNi-BPDA/C (Figure 2g).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images of all samples exhibit only the coralloid nanostructure of carbon substrates, excluding formation of metal-organic frameworks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM images of all samples exhibit only the coralloid nanostructure of carbon substrates, thus excluding the formation of metal-organic frameworks (Figures S8-S10).

nodes.characterization_summary: Overlapped Fe and Ni signals in energy-dispersive spectroscopy mapping confirm uniform distribution of Fe-Ni elements.
nodes.evidence_snippet: This result can also be verified by the overlapped Fe and Ni signals in the energy-dispersive spectroscopy mapping and the uniform distribution of Fe-Ni elements detected by the electron energy loss spectrum (Figures S12 and S13).

nodes.characterization_summary: Electron energy loss spectrum detects uniform distribution of Fe-Ni elements.
nodes.evidence_snippet: This result can also be verified by the overlapped Fe and Ni signals in the energy-dispersive spectroscopy mapping and the uniform distribution of Fe-Ni elements detected by the electron energy loss spectrum (Figures S12 and S13).
